channel.title: Wisconsin Public Radio - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Wisconsin Public Radio (wpr.org)

item.title: Lawmakers approve $10M for western Wisconsin mental health and treatment facility
item.description: Wisconsin lawmakers have released $10 million to help construct a new mental health and substance abuse treatment center in western Wisconsin. The post Lawmakers approve $10M for western Wisconsin mental health and treatment facility appeared first on WPR.

item.title: State finance committee approves bill to fund homeless veterans support
item.description: The bill would provide more money for care and support of veterans at nonprofits, but wouldn't provide the state VA with the means to reopen closed housing facilities in Green Bay and Chippewa Falls. The post State finance committee approves bill to fund homeless veterans support appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Milwaukee County Board approves new health care contract following lapse
item.description: Milwaukee County officials approved a new health care contract for employees and retirees on Thursday, just days after they learned that the old contract had expired at the end of last year. The post Milwaukee County Board approves new health care contract following lapse appeared first on WPR.

item.title: PFAS levels in Great Lakes fish are dropping, study finds
item.description: A new study shows PFAS levels in Great Lakes fish are on the decline as manufacturers have phased out some chemicals in recent decades. The post PFAS levels in Great Lakes fish are dropping, study finds appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin accuses Burger King franchise operator of thousands of child labor violations
item.description: The state's Department of Workforce Development is ordering the operator of more than 100 Wisconsin-based Burger King restaurants to pay back $237,437 in wages owed to teen employees. The post Wisconsin accuses Burger King franchise operator of thousands of child labor violations appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Milwaukee County passes ordinance to attempt to limit ICE from staging in county parks
item.description: Milwaukee County officials have passed an ordinance to prepare for the possible escalation of federal immigration enforcement agents in Wisconsin. The post Milwaukee County passes ordinance to attempt to limit ICE from staging in county parks appeared first on WPR.

item.title: How end of affirmative action is affecting Black and Hispanic enrollment at Wisconsin colleges
item.description: A cascade effect appears to be pushing more students of color to Wisconsin’s four-year public universities. The post How end of affirmative action is affecting Black and Hispanic enrollment at Wisconsin colleges appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin tribes respond to ICE presence in Minnesota
item.description: Many Wisconsin tribes are monitoring ICE and CBP actions closely, and issuing guidance to members to carry their tribal ID card and other documentation with them while immigration enforcement continues to ramp up. The post Wisconsin tribes respond to ICE presence in Minnesota appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Used bookstore searches for owner of antique photo album lost at Milwaukee Airport
item.description: The album was left behind for months in the terminal's lost and found before airport staff brought it to the bookstore for safekeeping. The post Used bookstore searches for owner of antique photo album lost at Milwaukee Airport appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin US Sen. Tammy Baldwin speaks out against GOP bill to restrict voting
item.description: Democratic U.S. Sen. Tammy Baldwin said Friday she adamantly opposes a GOP bill moving through Congress that would tighten voting access nationwide. The post Wisconsin US Sen. Tammy Baldwin speaks out against GOP bill to restrict voting appeared first on WPR.
